name: USDA NASS Cropland Data Layer (CDL)
description: The Cropland Data Layer (CDL) is an official annual agricultural land cover mapping program produced by the United States Department of Agriculture (USDA) National Agricultural Statistics Service (NASS). Spanning 1997 to the present, CDL provides high-resolution, geo-referenced, crop-specific land cover classification rasters for the contiguous United States at 30-meter and modern 10-meter resolutions. The collection identifies over 100 distinct crop types, pasture, woodland, water, and urban categories, serving as the benchmark standard for agricultural monitoring, crop acreage estimation, and land-use change research.
